metadata.mandatory_header: Developer-assistance report — not a security certificate or legal opinion.

executive_summary.headline_grade: NONE (Explicitly omitted per FRD §8 / Design §12: counts and coverage over grades)

methodology_and_exclusions.scanner_sandbox: Isolated runner with --network=none, non-root user, read-only repository mount, dropped Linux capabilities (Z4).
methodology_and_exclusions.repo_execution_policy: Zero repository code execution. Cloned scripts, install hooks, and test workflows are never executed (Safety Rule 1).
methodology_and_exclusions.advisory_resolver: Separated trusted resolution channel with strict domain allowlists (Z5).
limitations: Static analysis cannot prove the runtime absence of vulnerabilities (Unknown is never Pass).
Reverse proxies, API gateways, and external IAM providers cannot be observed from repository code alone.
DPDP readiness evaluation does not constitute a legal opinion or certify statutory compliance.
